t: You're on Dover Street in Mayfair, known for its Georgian architecture, its historic clubs and hotels, and a number of contemporary art galleries. At the junction with Piccadilly, opposite the Ritz, stands an equestrian sculpture by Elisabeth Frink. The street takes its name from Henry Jermyn, the first Baron Dover, an English courtier and favourite of James the Second. Two people were born here: Montagu Bertie, the sixth Earl of Abingdon, a peer and politician, and Robert Gosling, an English banker who lived from 1795 to 1869.
